Decode first. Scan line prefixes after spaces and optional 1-6 hashes plus a space. Number prefixes have 1-12 positive decimal components, each 1-6 digits without leading zeros, dot-separated; they set state (initially empty). @D truncates state to D components and increments the last, or appends .1 if one deeper; emit the resulting number. Prefixes end before optional trailing dot then space/tab/end. Preserve everything else. Print only.
